popularity.definitionKo: 대중이 즐기고 좋아할 수 있는 성질.
popularity.englishDescription: The characteristics of someone or something that the public enjoys and likes.

popularity.definitionKo: 어떤 대상에 쏠리는 많은 사람들의 높은 관심이나 좋아하는 마음.
popularity.englishDescription: Great interest or favor shown by many people to a certain person or thing.

ppaengdeogeomeom.definitionKo: 고전 소설 ‘심청전’에 나오는 인물 중 하나. 심청이의 계모로 심술궂고 수다스럽다. 심청이가 떠난 후 심 봉사의 재산을 탕진하고 결국에는 심 봉사를 버리고 떠나는 인물이다.
ppaengdeogeomeom.englishDescription: Ppaengdeok's mother: One of the characters in a novel from the late Joseon era, titled "Simcheongjeon", "The Tale of Sim Cheong"; she is the mean and talkative stepmother of Sim Cheong; she eventually squanders all of her husband's wealth and leaves him after Sim Cheong is sold as a virginal sacrificial offering to the sea.

preconception.definitionKo: 어떤 대상에 대하여 겪어 보지 않고 미리 짐작하여 가지는 생각.
preconception.englishDescription: A preconceived idea that one has before actually knowing an object.

preconception.definitionKo: 어떤 대상에 대하여 겪어 보지 않고 미리 짐작하여 가지는 생각.
preconception.englishDescription: A preconceived idea that one has before actually knowing an object.

preoccupation.englishDescription: A state of concentrating on only one thing or thought.

preoccupation.definitionKo: (속된 말로) 어떤 것에 지나치게 집착하거나 집중해서 정신을 못 차리는 상태가 됨.
preoccupation.englishDescription: (slang) A state of being so excessively obssessed with or concentrated on something that one loses one's reason.

printing.definitionKo: 글자나 글, 그림 등을 종이나 천 등에 기계로 찍어 냄.
printing.englishDescription: The physical act of pressing letters, words, graphics,  etc. onto a piece of paper or cloth with a machine.

printing.definitionKo: 신문이나 잡지 등에 글이나 그림 등을 실음.
printing.englishDescription: An act of publishing writings or pictures in a newspaper or magazine.

printing.definitionKo: 인쇄를 하는 일. 또는 그런 인쇄물.
printing.englishDescription: An act of printing something, or printed material.

printing.definitionKo: 천에 무늬를 찍는 일. 또는 그렇게 찍은 것.
printing.englishDescription: An act of printing patterns on a cloth, or such a printed cloth.

printing.definitionKo: 글이 인쇄되어 나옴. 또는 글을 인쇄하여 냄.
printing.englishDescription: A state in which a piece of writing is produced in printed form; or an act of producing a piece of writing in printed form.

profound.englishDescription: One's thinking being careful, not indiscreet.

profound.definitionKo: 마음이나 감정의 표현이 마음속에서 우러나와 아주 간절하다.
profound.englishDescription: The expression of one's mind or emotion being very sincere and serious.

profound.definitionKo: 사상이나 이론 등이 깊이가 있으며 이해할 수 없을 만큼 놀랍고 신기하다.
profound.englishDescription: An ideology, theory, etc., being profound and so marvelous and mysterious that it is hard to understand.

profound.definitionKo: 생각이나 사상, 이론 등이 헤아리기 어려울 정도로 매우 깊다.
profound.englishDescription: An idea, ideology, theory, etc., being so profound that it is hard to understand.

promoting.definitionKo: 어떤 주의나 주장, 사물의 좋은 점 등을 사람들에게 말하여 널리 알리는 데에 씀. 또는 그런 것.
promoting.englishDescription: The state of being used to widely spread a certain idea, argument, advantage of a commodity, etc., to other people, or such a thing.

publishing.definitionKo: 글, 그림, 악보 등을 책으로 만들어 세상에 내놓음.
publishing.englishDescription: An act of making pieces of writing, painting, music, etc., into a book or collection and releasing them in public.

publishing.definitionKo: 글, 그림, 악보 등을 책으로 만들어 세상에 내놓음.
publishing.englishDescription: The act of making pieces of writing, painting, music, etc., into a book or collection and releasing them in public.

pyeongan.englishDescription: Pyeongannam-do and Pyeonganbuk-do, or South Pyeongan Province and North Pyeongan Province.

re-entering.definitionKo: 한 번 들어갔던 학교에 다시 들어감.
re-entering.englishDescription: The act of entering again a school that one entered before.

re-review.definitionKo: 한 번 검토한 것을 다시 검토함.
re-review.englishDescription: The act of reviewing what has already been reviewed.

rebuking.definitionKo: 끈질기게 잔소리를 하거나 윽박지르고 혼을 냄.
rebuking.englishDescription: Nagging continuously, or scolding and bullying.

reference.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 그와 관련된 다른 일과 참고로 비교하고 대조해 봄.
reference.englishDescription: An act of comparing and contrasting something with another related thing for reference.
A word that is inteneded to emphasize a previuosly-mentioned object.

reference.definitionKo: 주의를 끌거나 문장을 끝낼 때 하는 말.
reference.englishDescription: A word that is intended to draw attention or finish a sentence.
A book or document that serves as the material for research.

reference.definitionKo: 연구나 조사를 하는 데 기본이 되는 재료.
reference.englishDescription: Material which is the basis for conducting study or research.
An act of talking about a certain matter or problem.

reference.definitionKo: 사물의 정도나 성격 등을 알기 위한 근거나 기준.
reference.englishDescription: Evidence or a yardstick needed to figure out the degree or characteristics of something.

reference.definitionKo: 어떤 대상을 가리켜 이르는 일. 또는 그런 이름.
reference.englishDescription: An act of referring to something, or a word used for such purpose.
An act of studying or considering something as a source of helpful information.
A book that serves as a reference in education.

reference.definitionKo: 교육에서, 교과서 외에 학습에 참고가 되는 책.
reference.englishDescription: A book that serves as a reference for learning, other than textbooks, in education.

reference.definitionKo: 어떤 것에 대하여 도움이 될 만한 의견을 말하는 사람.
reference.englishDescription: A person who states helpful opinions about something.

rehash.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 한 번 썼던 말이나 일 등을 다시 씀.
rehash.englishDescription: (figurative) The act of reusing what has been said, done, etc.

rehash.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 한 번 썼던 말이나 일 등을 다시 쓰다.
rehash.englishDescription: (figurative) To reuse what has been said, done, etc.

remarry.definitionKo: 결혼했던 여자가 남편과 사별하거나 이혼한 후 다른 남자와 다시 결혼하다.
remarry.englishDescription: For a woman to remarry someone after her husband's death or divorce.

remarry.definitionKo: 결혼했던 여자가 남편과 사별하거나 이혼한 후 다른 남자와 다시 결혼하다.
remarry.englishDescription: For a woman to get married again after losing her husband or getting a divorce.

renaissance.definitionKo: 14∼16세기에 이탈리아를 중심으로 하여 유럽 여러 나라에 일어난 문화 혁신 운동.
renaissance.englishDescription: A cultural innovation movement that occurred in many European countries, centering on Italy, between the 14th and 16th centuries

renaissance.definitionKo: 점점 약해져 가던 힘이나 세력이 중간에 다시 일어남. 또는 그렇게 함.
renaissance.englishDescription: For a waning power or group to regain strength along the way, or to cause such a situation to happen.

repeater.definitionKo: 이전에 죄를 지은 뒤 다시 죄를 지은 사람.
repeater.englishExpression: recurrence of crimes; repeater; repeated offender
repeater.englishDescription: A person who has committed a crime after having previously committed a crime.

repentance.englishDescription: An act of realizing one's shameful wrongdoings and regretting them.
An act of regretting one's mistakes and correcting them.

repentance.definitionKo: 이전에 자신이 한 일이 잘못임을 깨닫고 스스로 자신의 잘못을 나무람.
repentance.englishDescription: An act of realizing that what one did was wrong and reprimanding oneself for having done it.

ripplingly.definitionKo: 머리카락 등이 물결치는 것처럼 부드럽게 한 번 흔들리는 모양.
ripplingly.englishDescription: In the manner of hair, etc., moving softly once like the waves on the shore.

ripplingly.definitionKo: 머리카락 등이 물결치는 것처럼 부드럽게 자꾸 흔들리는 모양.
ripplingly.englishDescription: In the manner of hair, etc., moving softly like the waves on the shore.

rosseo.definitionKo: 어떤 물건의 재료나 원료를 나타내는 조사.
rosseo.englishDescription: A postpositional particle that indicates the material or ingredients of an object.

rosseo.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 하는 데 쓰이는 도구나 수단, 방법을 나타내는 조사.
rosseo.englishDescription: A postpositional particle that indicates a tool, method, or way used to do something.

rosseo.definitionKo: 앞말이 나타내는 것을 끝으로 이제까지 말한 내용이나 있었던 일을 포함하는 뜻을 나타내는 조사.
rosseo.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to indicate everything that has been said or done until the point of the preceding statement is included.

saint.definitionKo: 가톨릭에서, 성인으로 우러러보는 사람의 이름 앞에 쓰는 말.
saint.englishDescription: A word put before the name of a person who is respected as a saint in Catholicism.

saint.definitionKo: 지혜와 인격이 뛰어나 많은 사람들이 본받을 만한 사람.
saint.englishDescription: A person of wisdom and good character, many people admire as a role model.

saint.definitionKo: 천주교에서, 신앙과 인격이 뛰어난 사람을 가리키는 칭호.
saint.englishDescription: In Catholicism, the title given to a person who is beyond reproach in belief and character.

saint.definitionKo: 지혜와 인격이 뛰어나 많은 사람들이 본받을 만한 사람.
saint.englishDescription: A person of wisdom and good character, many people admire as a role model.

saint.definitionKo: 신자들이 높이 받들고 존경하는 종교적 위인.
saint.englishDescription: A religiously great person many believers respect and admire.

saint.definitionKo: 지혜롭고 현명하며 인격이 훌륭하여 많은 사람들이 본받을 만한 사람.
saint.englishDescription: A person revered for possessing wisdom, prudence and a superior disposition.

sansuhwa.definitionKo: 동양화에서, 아름다운 자연의 경치를 그린 그림.
sansuhwa.englishDescription: landscape painting: A type of oriental painting that depicts a beautiful natural scene.

scarfskin.definitionKo: 동물의 몸을 싸고 있는 피부의 가장 바깥쪽 부분.
scarfskin.englishDescription: The outermost part of skin wrapping an animal’s body.

seaman.definitionKo: 배를 조종하거나 배에서 일을 하는 사람.
seaman.englishDescription: A person who navigates or works on a ship.

sebum.definitionKo: 어떤 것에 묻어 있거나 섞여 있는 기름기.
sebum.englishDescription: The oil remaining on or mixed with something.
The oily substance secreted from the derma.

secondary.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 중심 인물이 아니고 그 곁에서 실속 없이 거들기만 하는 사람.
secondary.englishDescription: (figurative) A person who is not a central figure, but merely hangs around a central figure without being of much help.
Being ancillary to the main thing.

secondary.definitionKo: 두 번째가 되는. 또는 기본적인 것이나 주된 것에 붙어서 따르는.
secondary.englishDescription: Being the next after the first; annexed to a basic or primary thing.

secondary.definitionKo: 주된 것에 딸린 작고 중요하지 않은 부분에 관한 것.
secondary.englishDescription: Something related to a small, insignificant part that is attached to the main thing.

seething.definitionKo: 적은 양의 액체나 거품이 자꾸 끓거나 일어나는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
seething.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of a small amount of liquid boiling or small bubbles appearing.

seething.definitionKo: 좋지 않은 생각이 뒤섞여 마음이 계속 어지럽고 불편한 모양.
seething.englishDescription: In the state of feeling upset and uncomfortable due to unpleasant thoughts.

senior.definitionKo: 같은 분야에서 자기보다 훨씬 먼저 활동하여 경험이 더 많고 지위 등이 더 높은 사람.
senior.englishDescription: A person who is more experienced and holds a higher position than oneself because he/she started his/her career in the same field much earlier.

senior.definitionKo: 같은 학교를 자기보다 훨씬 먼저 졸업한 사람.
senior.englishDescription: A person who graduated from the same school much earlier than oneself.
A person who is higher than another in a rank or class.

senior.definitionKo: 자기보다 나이나 지위 등이 위인 사람.
senior.englishDescription: A person who is higher in age, status, etc., than oneself.

senior.definitionKo: 같은 분야에서 자기보다 먼저 활동하여 경험이나 지위 등이 더 앞선 사람.
senior.englishDescription: A person who is more experienced and holds a higher position than oneself because he/she started his/her career in the same field earlier.

senior.definitionKo: 같은 학교를 자기보다 먼저 입학한 사람.
senior.englishDescription: A person who graduated from the same school earlier than oneself.

senior.definitionKo: 나이나 지위, 신분 등이 자기보다 높아서 모셔야 하는 윗사람.
senior.englishDescription: A person who is older, or senior in status or position and thus should be treated with respect.

senior.definitionKo: 졸업을 앞둔 학년. 또는 그런 학생.
senior.englishDescription: A class that is about to graduate, or a student in such a class.

shadowing.definitionKo: 감시하거나 증거를 잡기 위하여 남의 뒤를 몰래 따라감.
shadowing.englishDescription: The act of secretly following someone in order to keep an eye on him/her or get evidence.

shilly-shally.definitionKo: 망설이기만 하고 결정을 짓지 못하는 점이 있다.
shilly-shally.englishDescription: Having the character of hesitating to make a decision.

shopkeeper.englishDescription: The owner of a business or shop.

shred.englishDescription: To tear something into many pieces and scatter them.
To break, tear, and throw away something.

shrew.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 몹시 변덕스럽고 못된, 꾀가 많은 여자.
shrew.englishDescription: (figurative) A very fickle, ill-tempered, and cunning woman.

shrinking.englishDescription: The state of becoming small and insignificant, or the act of making something small and insignificant.

signpost.definitionKo: 도로에서 어느 장소까지의 거리나 방향을 알려 주는 표지.
signpost.englishDescription: A sign on a road that shows the distance or direction to a place.

signpost.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 어떤 일이나 목적의 기준이 될 만한 일.
signpost.englishDescription: (figurative) Something that can serve as a standard for something or a purpose.

signpost.definitionKo: 어떤 것을 표시하기 위해 세운 말뚝.
signpost.englishDescription: A stake installed to indicate a certain message.

sit-down.definitionKo: 사람들이 어떤 목적을 이루기 위해 한곳에 자리를 잡고 시위하다.
sit-down.englishDescription: For a group of people to stage a sit-in in order to achieve a certain purpose.

skilled.englishDescription: Not bad at doing something because one has often experienced it.

skilled.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 여러 번 하여 서투르지 않다.

skilled.definitionKo: 재주나 기술 등이 매우 뛰어나고 익숙하다.
skilled.englishDescription: One's talent or skill being very excellent and practiced.
One's talent being outstanding and special.
One's work or skills, etc., having developed fully.

sloppily.definitionKo: 뚜렷하거나 적극적인 의지 없이 되는대로 행동하는 모양.
sloppily.englishDescription: In the manner of behaving irresponsibly without a definite or strong will.

sloppily.definitionKo: 어떤 말이나 상황을 남이 모르는 사이에 슬쩍 넘겨 버리는 모양.
sloppily.englishDescription: In the manner of glossing over a certain remark or situation when others do not know about it.

sloppily.definitionKo: 옷이나 종이 등이 젖거나 빳빳한 기운이 빠져 보기 흉하게 축 늘어져 있는 상태로.
sloppily.englishDescription: In the state of clothes or paper, etc., being wet or losing their firmness, drooping in an ugly and feeble manner.

sloppiness.englishDescription: The quality of not being prudent or careful, but being off guard, letting one's guard down.

smash.definitionKo: 단단한 물건을 쳐서 조각이 나게 하다.
smash.englishDescription: To hit a hard object and break it into pieces.

smash.definitionKo: 단단한 물체를 맨손이나 발, 머리로 쳐서 깨뜨리다.

smash.englishDescription: To pound an object to break it into many tiny pieces.

smash.definitionKo: 어떤 물체를 깨뜨려 여러 조각을 내다.
smash.englishDescription: To break something into several pieces.

smash.englishDescription: To hammer a solid object and break it into pieces.

smash.definitionKo: 단단한 물체를 깨뜨려 작은 조각이나 가루가 되게 하다.
smash.englishDescription: To break a solid object into small pieces or powder.

smash.definitionKo: 어떤 물체를 깨뜨려 여러 조각을 내다.
smash.englishDescription: To break something into several pieces.

smash.definitionKo: 단단한 물체를 쳐서 조각이 나게 하다.
smash.englishDescription: To hit a hard object and break it into pieces.
To strike or hit hard and smash something.
To make something become completely broken.

snack.definitionKo: 밀가루나 쌀가루 등에 우유, 설탕 등을 넣고 반죽하여 굽거나 튀긴 간식.
snack.englishDescription: Snacks baked or fried by mixing milk, sugar, etc., into flour or rice powder.

snack.definitionKo: 일을 하다가 잠시 쉬면서 먹는 음식.

snack.definitionKo: 식사와 식사 사이에 간단히 먹는 음식.
snack.englishDescription: Food that one eats between meals.

snack.definitionKo: 일을 하다가 잠깐 쉬는 동안에 먹는 음식.
snack.englishDescription: Food that one eats during a brief rest while doing something.

snack.definitionKo: 아침, 점심, 저녁 식사 외에 꼭 필요하지 않은 음식을 먹다.
snack.englishDescription: To eat snacks in addition to breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

snail.definitionKo: 나선형의 껍데기를 지고 다니며 머리에 두 더듬이와 눈이 있는 동물.
snail.englishDescription: An animal that has a spiral shell on the back and two feelers and eyes on the head.

soar.englishDescription: For a rank or price to surge.

soar.englishDescription: To rise from bottom to top strongly or immediately.

soar.englishDescription: For prices, etc., to go up suddenly.

soar.definitionKo: 어떤 느낌이나 힘 등이 강하게 생기다.

For a quantity to increase sharply, suddenly.
To fly up  in the air.

soar.definitionKo: 기온이나 가격, 비율 등이 갑자기 빠르게 오르다.
soar.englishDescription: For the temperature, price, proportion, etc., to suddenly rise quickly.

uniform.definitionKo: 학교나 회사 등의 조직에서 정해진 규정에 따라 입는 옷.
uniform.englishDescription: A set of clothing worn in accordance with rules at organizations such as a school, company, etc.

uniform.definitionKo: 여럿이 각각의 특성이 없이 모두 거의 비슷한.
uniform.englishDescription: Many things being similar to each other without any unique characteristics.

uniform.definitionKo: 여럿이 모두 똑같아서 마치 하나와 같다.
uniform.englishDescription: Different things or persons' looking or behaving the same as if they were one.

uniform.definitionKo: 모두가 조금도 다른 데가 없이 꼭 같다.
uniform.englishDescription: Different things or people being exactly the same in their thoughts, opinions, etc.
Everything being identical without any differences.

unorthodoxy.definitionKo: 권위 있는 사상이나 학설 등에 반항하는 주장이나 이론.
unorthodoxy.englishDescription: Any opinion or theory that rejects an authoritative idea, theory, etc.

unorthodoxy.definitionKo: 정통 교리에 어긋나는 주장을 하여 정통으로 인정되지 않는 종교.
unorthodoxy.englishDescription: A religion that is not recognized as an orthodoxy because it rejects the orthodox doctrines of a certain religion.

up.definitionKo: 어디에 붙어 있던 물건이 위로 쉽게 들리는 모양.
up.englishDescription: A word describing one lifting an object easily that has been stuck to something.
The upper side of an object.

urticaria.definitionKo: 약이나 음식을 잘못 먹거나 또는 환경의 변화로 인해 피부 여기저기에 붉게 솟아오르는 것.
urticaria.englishDescription: A type of skin disorder featuring red bumps either due to an intake of certain food or medicine, or due to a change in environment.

vulgar.englishDescription: Being low class, lacking decency and refinement.
One's way of talking or behavior being unrefined and crude.

vulgar.definitionKo: 말이나 행동이 매우 교양이 없고 천하다.
vulgar.englishDescription: One's way of talking or behavior being unrefined and crude.

vulgar.definitionKo: 생각의 수준이 낮거나 말과 행동 등이 천하고 교양이 없다.
vulgar.englishDescription: Thinking, speaking, acting, etc., in an ignoble and unrefined manner.

vulgar.definitionKo: 하는 짓 또는 생긴 모양새나 됨됨이가 고상한 맛이 없이 상스럽다.
vulgar.englishDescription: One's behavior, appearance, or personality being unrefined and coarse.

vulgar.definitionKo: 사람의 성품이 고상하지 못하고 천한 데가 있다.
vulgar.englishDescription: Not elegant, ignoble in one's personality.

wa.englishDescription: The name of the vowel 'ㅘ' in the Korean alphabet.

wa.definitionKo: 한글 자모 ‘ㅗ’와 ‘ㅏ’를 모아 쓴 글자. 이름은 ‘와’이고 중성으로 쓴다.
wa.englishDescription: The compound vowel of the Korean alphabet pronounced 'wa', which is made by adding 'ㅐ' to 'ㅗ' and used as a middle vowel letter.

wa.definitionKo: 비교의 대상이거나 기준으로 삼는 대상임을 나타내는 조사.
wa.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to indicate that something is the subject of a comparison or subject of a standard.

wa.definitionKo: 무엇인가를 상대로 하여 어떤 일을 할 때 그 상대임을 나타내는 조사.
wa.englishDescription: A postpositional particle that indicates the person who one is doing something with.

wa.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 함께 하는 대상임을 나타내는 조사.
wa.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to indicate the person one is doing something with.

wa.definitionKo: 앞과 뒤의 명사를 같은 자격으로 이어주는 조사.
wa.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to list the preceding and following nouns on an equal footing.

welter.englishDescription: To roll from place to place.

whisperingly.definitionKo: 남이 알아듣지 못하도록 작은 목소리로 자꾸 말하는 소리.
whisperingly.englishDescription: In the manner of speaking in a small voice so that others cannot hear.

wing.definitionKo: 새나 곤충의 몸 양쪽에 붙어서 날 때 쓰는 기관.
wing.englishDescription: The organ in a bird or insect, attached to each side of the body, which is used when flying.

wing.definitionKo: 비행기의 양쪽 옆에 길고 넓적하게 달려서 비행기가 공중에 잘 뜰 수 있게 해 주는 부분.
wing.englishDescription: The part attached to either side of the body, enabling an airplane to fly well in the air.

wing.definitionKo: 선풍기 등의 기계에서 바람을 일으키는 부분.
wing.englishDescription: The part in a machine such as an electric fan, etc., that makes the wind.
One of the wings of a bird.

wings.englishDescription: Both wings of a bird that are fully spread.

younger.definitionKo: 가족 관계에서 나이나 위치가 자기보다 적거나 아래인 사람.
younger.englishDescription: A person who is younger or lower than oneself in age or position in a family relationship.
Having a lower age in comparison with someone else.

yutpan.definitionKo: 윷놀이를 할 때 말을 쓰는 자리를 종이 등에 그린 판.
yutpan.englishDescription: score board; score table: In yunnori, a traditional Korean family board game, the score is table drawn on paper, etc., to record the locations of pieces.
yunnori board: A mat on which yunnori, a traditional Korean family board game, takes place.

zoo.definitionKo: 여러 동물들을 가두어 기르면서 사람들이 구경할 수 있도록 해 놓은 곳.
zoo.englishDescription: A place that cages and raises all kinds of animals and allows people to look at them.

zoo.definitionKo: 많은 사람들이 모여 여러 종류의 물건을 무질서하게 사고파는 시끄럽고 어수선한 시장.
zoo.englishDescription: A noisy, chaotic market bustling with many people selling and buying a variety of things in a disheveled manner.
